jobs.titulo: How AI Turns Words Into Images (Explained in 4 Minutes)
jobs.descripcion:
You type six words — "an astronaut riding a horse" — and seconds later there's a photograph of something that never existed. Where did it come from? In this video, you'll see how AI builds images out of pure noise: how your words become a destination on a map, how the picture is carved out of static step by step, and why it still draws extra fingers.
